registers.label: Spare
lines: The boy Samuel heard his name in the night.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening.
You have searched me and known me, O God.
You knew my words before I spoke them.
Jesus said: come and see. I saw you.
Where the world overlooks us, you know us by name.
Come, let us worship the God who calls.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: In the night, when the lamp of God had not yet gone out, a voice called a boy by name — and called, and called again.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening.
O Lord, you have searched me and you know me; you knit me together, you trace my path, you know my sitting down and my rising up.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening.
Jesus saw Nathanael under the fig tree before anyone introduced them, and said simply: come and see.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening.
So we come, already known and already called, and we open our ears to the One who names us.
Speak, Lord, your servant is listening. Amen.
